business_summary.text: Varmora Granito Limited manufactures and sells ceramic tiles and related products.

call_points.text: FY27 revenue growth targeted at 15% in value and 10% in volume.
No immediate capex plans; growth to come from improving utilization toward 92-93% peak.
Average realization improved by ₹75/meter YoY, with ₹25 from product mix.
Assam plant utilization expected to reach 75% in Q3 and 85-87% in Q4.
Marketing spend maintained at 1.9% of revenue.
IST technology produces 100% replica of natural marble at a fraction of the cost.
Morbi propane prices averaged ₹80.53 in Q2, currently at ₹92.

exceptions: board and committee meetings not held as SEBI's rules specify

guidance.statement: around 15% growth on value and 10% on the volume side.

operating_notes.text: Commenced production and sales at Allemby Ceramics Private Limited in Tezpur, Assam.
Retail business accounts for 72% of domestic sales.
Outsourced mix stands at 14%, primarily for low-value PVT and ceramics.

timeline.summary: Q1FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹315.27 Cr, net profit to shareholders ₹12.64 Cr.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹398.97 Cr, net profit to shareholders ₹45.32 Cr.
Varmora Granito filed its Q1, Q2, and H1 FY27 operational and financial performance presentation on October 20, 2026.
Vallabhdas Vallabhdas and Bhavesh Vallabhdas Varmora, Managing Director, disclosed the audio recording of the Q3FY27 analyst meet on October 23, 2026, available at the company’s website.
Varmora Granito held its first earnings call as a listed company, reporting strong Q2 margin expansion and outlining a 15% revenue growth target for FY27.
